prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in West Palm Beach FL to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, home type, and price range. Based on the available West Palm Beach data, **Jeff Tricoli’s team** is a strong starting point for a typical residential sale: Zillow reports substantial local sales activity and more than 1,000 team reviews. **Sandra Rathe** and **Larry Mastropieri** also appear among the top performers in a recent HomeLight ranking, which considers sales and seller metrics.

I’d interview two or three agents before choosing. Ask each for **recent sales near your home**, their suggested list price and the comparable sales behind it, a marketing plan, and their commission and cancellation terms. Make sure the person who will actually handle your sale has experience with your specific neighborhood and property type. Sources: [Zillow’s West Palm Beach agent directory](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/west-palm-beach-fl/) and [HomeLight’s West Palm Beach rankings](https://www.homelight.com/west-palm-beach-fl/top-real-estate-agents).
